description: Record and replay HTTP + WebSocket traffic for Playwright E2E tests: SSR proxy for Next.js and TanStack Start, browser HAR, deterministic CI with the backend off
rules: Point the app's API base URL at the proxy (http://localhost:8100 by default) in dev and test only; keep the real backend in production, gated on NODE_ENV and TEST_PROXY_RECORDER_ENABLED
Scaffold with `npx test-proxy-recorder init <backend-url> --port 8100 --dir ./e2e/recordings`; it writes the config, Playwright fixture, global teardown and scripts and overwrites nothing
In Playwright fixtures call playwrightProxy.before(page, testInfo, mode, { url }) per test and playwrightProxy.teardown() in global teardown; mode is 'record', 'replay' or 'transparent'

Next.js: tag server-side fetches with registerProxyFetch() from 'test-proxy-recorder/nextjs' in the root layout, or registerProxyAxios(instance) for axios; setNextProxyHeaders middleware is optional and does not tag fetches by itself
Record against a production build (next build && next start) with TEST_PROXY_RECORDER_ENABLED=true and --workers 1, never against next dev; commit the recordings and replay on CI with the backend off
Authorization, Cookie and Set-Cookie are redacted by default; log in through a Playwright setup project in 'transparent' mode and save storageState instead of recording credentials
